Private Coaching by Request

Private coaching is available by request and is not a drop-in group class.

Morning private coaching is available by request. Text Sandy to discuss goals and availability.

Arrive at 6045 Main Street, Tannersville

Sensei Sandy BJJ occupies a 2nd floor studio above Main Street.

  • 6045 Main Street, 2nd Floor Studio
  • Tannersville, NY 12485
